name: orbit
description: A globe of everything your Claude session talks to: tool calls, sockets and bytes traced to hosts, countries and orgs, with a deny-list that blocks before a call runs.

location.title: Where you are (for the red dot)
location.description: Latitude and longitude of the red dot on the globe, e.g. "49.28,-123.12 Vancouver". Blank: run /orbit locate once, or the globe centers on 0,0.

enforcement.title: What to do with a host you have not allowed
enforcement.description: The mode every session starts in, the same four as /orbit mode. off watches and blocks nothing. denylist blocks only what you listed with /orbit block. allowlist blocks everything not on your list. ask asks about each new host with a dialog, 8 seconds, then blocks. /orbit mode changes it for the session you are in, and /orbit rules shows it.

picture.title: How the globe is drawn
picture.description: auto draws real pixels where the terminal can (kitty, Ghostty) and colored half-blocks everywhere else, so most people never touch this. Forcing real pixels in a terminal that cannot draw them leaves the pane saying so.
options: always real pixels (kitty or Ghostty only)

geoDatabase.title: City database (blank: the one /orbit geodb gets)
geoDatabase.description: Path of a MaxMind-format city or country database (DB-IP Lite, GeoLite2). Blank uses the DB-IP Lite files /orbit geodb downloads into ~/.claude/orbit/geo.

asnDatabase.title: Organization database (blank: the one /orbit geodb gets)
asnDatabase.description: Path of a MaxMind-format ASN database, which fills the org column. Blank uses the DB-IP ASN Lite file /orbit geodb downloads.

proxy.title: Start the proxy layer every session
proxy.description: true runs a local HTTPS proxy for the commands and MCP servers this session starts, so their hosts, bytes and latency reach the globe without decrypting anything; it sets HTTPS_PROXY for them. /orbit proxy on does this for one session.

fadeSeconds.title: Seconds an arc stays on the globe
fadeSeconds.description: How long a finished connection's arc lingers before it fades. Higher is calmer, lower is busier.

autoLog.title: Write the trace to disk every session
autoLog.description: true keeps this session's calls as JSONL in ~/.claude/orbit/traces, which is what /orbit replay reads. false writes nothing.

statusLine.title: Show hosts and countries at the bottom of the terminal
statusLine.description: The status line is the thin bar along the bottom of your terminal. true puts a count there, e.g. "orbit · 6 hosts · 3 countries". false leaves the bottom alone.

node.title: Node.js to run the helpers (blank: node)
node.description: The node executable for the geo and proxy helpers, a name on PATH or a full path. Blank uses node from your PATH. The globe still draws without it; the city names and the proxy layer need it.
